items.title: Nanopore sequencing combined with adaptive sampling and NanoExpansion enables accurate characterization of repeat expansion disorders.
items.summary: Expansion repeat disorders are caused by abnormal expansions of short tandem repeats (STRs). We evaluated targeted long-read nanopore sequencing for comprehensive characterization of STR expansions in 132 participants, including patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1, n = 51) and DM2 ( n = 3) already characterized by Southern blot, C9orf72 -associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS n = 11) evaluated by repeat primed polymerase chain reaction (RP-PCR; validation group), suspected spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA, n = 46), cerebellar ataxia with neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS; n = 13), Huntington's disease (1), Kennedy disease (1), Friedreich ataxia (FRDA, 2), and 4 healthy controls (test group). Native DNA was sequenced using adaptive sampling (AS) on Oxford Nanopore GridION or PromethION-2Solo platforms. Long-PCR sequencing was performed for comparison. We also developed NanoExpansion, a Python-based tool for sizing expanded alleles and detecting sequence interruptions. We correctly characterized all DM1, DM2, ALS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, and Kennedy disease cases, and identified eight SCA27B, two SCA37, three SCA31, one SCA3, and nine CANVAS cases. Compared with the AS approach, long-PCR underestimated alleles exceeding 800 repeats. Repeat interruptions were detected in 27/51 (52.9%) DM1 cases and 1/10 (10%) ALS, but not in CANVAS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, Kennedy disease, or SCA cases. This integrated sequencing analysis pipeline provides accurate, comprehensive characterization of repeat expansion disorders and has the potential to improve routine genetic diagnosis.
items.titleZh: 纳米孔测序结合自适应采样与NanoExpansion可实现对重复扩增疾病的准确表征
items.summaryZh: 该研究在132名参与者中评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序（结合自适应采样）对多种短串联重复扩增疾病的检测能力，涵盖DM1/DM2、C9orf72相关ALS、SCA、CANVAS、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病和FRDA。研究同时开发了NanoExpansion工具用于确定扩增等位基因大小和检测序列中断。结果显示该方法能正确表征所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出多例SCA和CANVAS；长PCR在超过800个重复时会低估等位基因长度。重复中断在部分DM1和ALS病例中被检出。
items.insight: 该工作将长读长纳米孔测序与自适应采样及专用分析工具结合，为C9orf72等重复扩增相关ALS的基因分型提供了比传统长PCR更准确的技术路径，尤其对超大扩增等位基因和序列中断的解析有助于理解ALS遗传机制并推动常规诊断流程更新。

items.abstractZh: 重复扩增疾病由短串联重复序列（STR）的异常扩增引起。我们评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序在132名参与者中对STR扩增进行全面表征的能力，参与者包括已通过Southern blot鉴定的强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1，n=51）和2型（DM2，n=3）患者、通过重复引物聚合酶链反应（RP-PCR）评估的C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS，n=11；验证组）、疑似脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA，n=46）、小脑性共济失调伴神经病和前庭反射消失综合征（CANVAS；n=13）、亨廷顿病（1例）、肯尼迪病（1例）、弗里德赖希共济失调（FRDA，2例）以及4名健康对照（测试组）。使用Oxford Nanopore GridION或PromethION-2Solo平台上的自适应采样（AS）对天然DNA进行测序。同时进行长PCR测序以作比较。我们还开发了NanoExpansion，一个基于Python的工具，用于确定扩增等位基因的大小并检测序列中断。我们正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出8例SCA27B、2例SCA37、3例SCA31、1例SCA3和9例CANVAS病例。与AS方法相比，长PCR低估了超过800个重复的等位基因。在27/51（52.9%）的DM1病例和1/10（10%）的ALS病例中检测到重复中断，但在CANVAS、FRDA、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病或SCA病例中未检测到。该整合测序分析流程可对重复扩增疾病进行准确、全面的表征，并有望改善常规遗传诊断。
items.frontierRationale: 新近开发的长读长纳米孔测序整合流程可准确解析C9orf72相关ALS等重复扩增疾病，具有改善常规遗传诊断的转化价值。

items.title: Enzymatic N-deacylation is the predicted membrane-disruption switch for sphingomyelin: a falsifiable in-silico framework for sphingolipid vulnerability in ALS.
items.summary: Sphingolipid dysregulation is an emerging feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but no systematic method separates species that may worsen axon-myelin membrane integrity from matter that may counteract it. We present an in-silico framework classifying sphingolipids and designed derivatives as candidate membrane-disruptive or candidate protective species, scored against real biological referents using externally published tools rather than a bespoke composite. Its central finding concerns a single, chemically defined difference in lipid state. In coarse-grained (MARTINI 3) molecular dynamics with three independent replicates per system, intact palmitoyl-sphingomyelin is indistinguishable from a pure-POPC bilayer (leaflet-mean Δ thickness + 0.001 nm, 95% CI brackets zero), whereas the modeled N-deacylated form thins it in every replicate (Δ=-0.043 nm, [- 0.046, - 0.041]), tracking a lyso-phosphatidylcholine detergent control (-0.083 nm, [- 0.087, - 0.080]) on two concordant estimators. Because only one lyso-sphingolipid is parameterized in public MARTINI 3, N-deacylation is not established here as a class-wide effect. Across eleven ALS studies (2021-2026), six report elevated serine-palmitoyltransferase (SPT) pathway sphingolipids, all in monogenic SPTLC1/SPTLC2 cohorts, whereas sporadic cohorts show disturbance without a shared direction. Because the simulations do not address whether this species is produced, accumulates, or reaches pathological concentrations in ALS tissue, we present the ALS connection as hypothesis-generating rather than direct evidence. Separately, an explicitly exploratory arm reports two designed modulators with predicted target engagement (Boltz-2) and an ADMET triage of their liabilities. The primary contribution is the membrane result with a wet-lab panel that makes it falsifiable.

items.titleZh: 酶促N-脱酰化被预测为鞘磷脂的膜破坏开关：一个用于ALS中鞘脂脆弱性的可证伪计算机框架
items.summaryZh: 该研究用计算机模拟框架评估鞘脂对细胞膜的影响，发现N-脱酰化鞘磷脂在模拟中使膜变薄，而完整鞘磷脂不影响膜厚度。作者分析11项ALS研究后指出，SPT通路鞘脂升高仅见于单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列，散发性ALS无一致方向。研究强调这是假设生成性工作，未证明该脂质在ALS组织中产生或积累，并提出湿实验方案以验证。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS中鞘脂代谢紊乱提供了一个可证伪的机制假设：N-脱酰化鞘磷脂可能通过破坏膜完整性参与疾病，而非仅作为生物标志物。其价值在于将计算预测与明确的湿实验验证路径结合，并区分了单基因与散发性ALS的脂质特征差异，有助于设计针对特定亚群的鞘脂靶向研究。

items.abstractZh: 鞘脂失调是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的一个新兴特征，但尚无系统方法将可能恶化轴突-髓鞘膜完整性的脂质种类与可能起对抗作用的物质区分开来。我们提出了一个计算机框架，将鞘脂及设计衍生物分类为候选膜破坏性或候选保护性种类，并使用外部已发表的工具而非定制的复合评分，对照真实生物学参照物进行评分。其核心发现涉及脂质状态中一个化学上明确的单一差异。在粗粒化（MARTINI 3）分子动力学模拟中，每个系统三个独立重复，完整的棕榈酰-鞘磷脂与纯POPC双分子层无法区分（小叶平均厚度变化 +0.001 nm，95% CI包含零），而建模的N-脱酰化形式在每个重复中均使其变薄（Δ=-0.043 nm，[-0.046, -0.041]），在两个一致估计量上追随溶血磷脂酰胆碱去垢剂对照（-0.083 nm，[-0.087, -0.080]）。由于公共MARTINI 3中仅有一种溶血鞘脂被参数化，N-脱酰化在此并未被确立为全类效应。在十一项ALS研究（2021-2026）中，六项报告丝氨酸棕榈酰转移酶（SPT）通路鞘脂升高，均来自单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列，而散发性队列显示紊乱但无共同方向。由于模拟未涉及该种类在ALS组织中是否产生、积累或达到病理浓度，我们将ALS关联作为假设生成而非直接证据呈现。另外，一个明确探索性分支报告了两种设计调节剂具有预测的靶点结合（Boltz-2）及其 liability 的ADMET分诊。主要贡献是膜结果及使其可证伪的湿实验面板。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年提出可证伪的计算机框架，将鞘脂N-脱酰化与ALS膜脆弱性机制关联，并给出湿实验验证路径，具有机制转化价值。

items.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.
items.summary: Acidic cannabinoids, including tetrahydrocannabinolic acid (THCA), cannabidiolic acid (CBDA), cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), and related biosynthetic precursors, represent the predominant phytocannabinoid forms naturally produced by Cannabis sativa. Long considered pharmacologically inactive intermediates, these compounds are now increasingly recognized as bioactive molecules with potential therapeutic relevance for brain disorders. Compared with their decarboxylated counterparts, acidic cannabinoids exhibit distinct physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic properties that may confer reduced psychotropic liability together with unique neurobiological effects. Emerging preclinical evidence indicates that acidic cannabinoids modulate multiple processes implicated in neurological and psychiatric disorders, including serotonergic and endocannabinoid signaling, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, calcium dyshomeostasis, and synaptic transmission. In this review, we critically examine current knowledge regarding acidic cannabinoids in the context of brain disorders. We first summarize their biosynthesis, chemical stability, pharmacokinetic characteristics, and pharmacological differences from neutral cannabinoids. We then examine preclinical evidence supporting their potential therapeutic effects in epilepsy, anxiety, depression, psychosis-related conditions, and neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We also discuss how artificial intelligence and computational approaches may support target identification, formulation optimization, pharmacokinetic modeling, and the development of personalized cannabinoid-based interventions. Finally, we highlight key methodological and translational challenges limiting the field and outline priorities for future research. Overall, acidic cannabinoids emerge as promising but still underexplored multitarget compounds with potential relevance for the treatment of brain disorders.

items.titleZh: 酸性大麻素类化合物在脑部疾病中的作用：神经生物学机制、临床前证据与转化挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）的生物学特征与脑部疾病相关临床前证据。要点：①这类化合物并非惰性中间体，具有独立药理活性，且精神活性风险可能低于脱羧形式；②临床前研究提示其可作用于5-羟色胺能/内源性大麻素信号、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能、钙稳态和突触传递等多条通路；③综述覆盖癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和ALS等神经退行性疾病；④讨论了AI在靶点识别、制剂优化和药代建模中的潜在作用；⑤强调方法学与转化瓶颈仍是主要限制。全文为临床前证据汇总，不构成临床疗效结论。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，价值在于把酸性大麻素作为一类多靶点候选分子纳入神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和钙稳态失衡等ALS相关病理通路的讨论框架，并提示其低精神活性倾向可能有利于长期干预开发。但当前证据全部来自临床前研究，综述本身不提供ALS临床疗效数据，适合作为机制假设和临床前实验设计的参考，而非治疗推荐依据。

items.abstractZh: 酸性大麻素类化合物，包括四氢大麻酚酸（THCA）、大麻二酚酸（CBDA）、大麻萜酚酸（CBGA）及相关生物合成前体，是Cannabis sativa天然产生的主要植物大麻素形式。这些化合物长期被视为药理惰性中间体，如今日益被认为是对脑部疾病具有潜在治疗相关性的生物活性分子。与脱羧对应物相比，酸性大麻素类化合物具有独特的理化、药代动力学和药效学特性，可能赋予其较低的精神活性倾向以及独特的神经生物学效应。新兴的临床前证据表明，酸性大麻素类化合物可调节与神经和精神疾病相关的多种过程，包括5-羟色胺能信号、内源性大麻素信号、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、钙稳态失衡和突触传递。在本综述中，我们批判性地审视了酸性大麻素类化合物在脑部疾病背景下的当前知识。我们首先总结其生物合成、化学稳定性、药代动力学特征以及与中性大麻素的药理学差异。随后，我们审视支持其在癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况以及神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）中潜在治疗效果的临床前证据。我们还讨论了人工智能和计算方法如何支持靶点识别、制剂优化、药代动力学建模以及个性化大麻素干预措施的开发。最后，我们强调了限制该领域的关键方法学和转化挑战，并概述了未来研究的优先事项。总体而言，酸性大麻素类化合物作为有前景但仍未被充分探索的多靶点化合物出现，对脑部疾病的治疗具有潜在相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统整合了酸性大麻素在神经退行性疾病（含ALS）中的临床前机制证据，并引入AI辅助转化策略，具有机制探索与早期转化参考价值。

items.title: Biomarker-Guided Diagnosis of Riboflavin Transporter Deficiency Presenting as Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis: A Short Report from a Consanguineous Family.
items.summary: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere syndrome (BVVLS) is a rare, treatable neurodegenerative disorder caused by riboflavin transporter gene variants (SLC52A2, SLC52A3). Early symptoms can mimic neuromuscular junction disorders, causing diagnostic delays. A 3.5-year-old girl from consanguineous parents presented at 2.5 years with isolated bilateral ptosis, later developing dysphagia, dysphonia, facial diplegia, stridor, and respiratory compromise. Examination revealed tongue atrophy with fasciculations and bulbar weakness but normal limb strength. Diagnosed with seronegative myasthenia gravis, she failed to respond to corticosteroids, pyridostigmine, salbutamol, and intravenous immunoglobulin. Absence of fatigability, lower motor neuron signs, and a sibling history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy prompted genetic testing revealed a homozygous missense variant in SLC52A3 (c.670T > C; p.Phe224Leu). High-dose riboflavin (up to 50 mg/kg/day) led to gradual improvement in bulbar function, resolution of stridor, and respiratory stabilization, though ptosis and tongue fasciculations persisted. This report is novel in using clinical response to riboflavin as a functional biomarker for riboflavin transporter deficiency (RTD) in a patient with a variant of uncertain significance, unlike prior cases with definitive genetics. Empiric riboflavin challenge offers a practical framework when genetic results are ambiguous. RTD should be suspected in children with treatment-resistant, non-fluctuating ptosis and bulbar weakness, particularly with consanguinity or family history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy. Early high-dose riboflavin prevents decline, while immunosuppression is ineffective and potentially harmful.

items.titleZh: 生物标志物引导诊断表现为血清阴性重症肌无力的核黄素转运体缺乏症：一个近亲婚配家庭的简短报告
items.summaryZh: 本报告描述一名近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女孩，早期表现为双侧上睑下垂，后被误诊为血清阴性重症肌无力，对多种免疫治疗无反应。基因检测发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异，确诊为核黄素转运体缺乏症（Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征）。大剂量核黄素治疗后延髓功能和呼吸状况改善，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续。作者提出，在基因变异意义未明时，核黄素激发试验的临床反应可作为功能性生物标志物辅助诊断。
items.insight: 该报告提示，对于表现为治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是有近亲婚配或家族性听力损失和延髓麻痹史者，应警惕核黄素转运体缺乏症而非重症肌无力。核黄素激发试验作为功能性生物标志物的思路，对ALS及其他神经退行性疾病的早期鉴别诊断和可治疗疾病的识别具有借鉴意义，可避免不必要的免疫抑制治疗。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在SLC52A3意义未明变异患者中，大剂量核黄素治疗后的临床改善可作为核黄素转运体缺乏症的功能性诊断依据，且免疫抑制治疗无效。

items.abstractZh: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征（BVVLS）是一种罕见的、可治疗的神经退行性疾病，由核黄素转运体基因变异（SLC52A2、SLC52A3）引起。早期症状可模仿神经肌肉接头疾病，导致诊断延迟。一名来自近亲婚配父母的3.5岁女孩在2.5岁时表现为孤立性双侧上睑下垂，随后出现吞咽困难、发声困难、双侧面瘫、喘鸣和呼吸功能受损。检查发现舌萎缩伴肌束颤动和延髓肌无力，但肢体肌力正常。被诊断为血清阴性重症肌无力，对皮质类固醇、吡啶斯的明、沙丁胺醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白均无反应。无疲劳性、下运动神经元体征以及同胞有听力损失和延髓麻痹病史促使进行基因检测，发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异（c.670T > C；p.Phe224Leu）。大剂量核黄素（高达50 mg/kg/天）使延髓功能逐渐改善，喘鸣消失，呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续存在。本报告的新颖之处在于，在一名携带意义未明变异的患者中，将核黄素临床反应用作核黄素转运体缺乏症（RTD）的功能性生物标志物，这与先前具有明确遗传学证据的病例不同。当遗传结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验提供了实用框架。对于治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是有近亲婚配或听力损失和延髓麻痹家族史者，应怀疑RTD。早期大剂量核黄素可防止病情恶化，而免疫抑制无效且可能有害。
items.frontierRationale: 该报告提出以核黄素临床反应作为意义未明变异的功能性生物标志物，为可治疗神经退行性疾病的早期精准诊断提供了新近的转化思路。

items.title: An integrative transcriptomic atlas of ALS and aging skeletal muscle defines shared and distinct molecular programs of degeneration.
items.summary: Skeletal muscle atrophy and weakness resulting from loss of motor neuron innervation are shared hallmarks of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and age-associated sarcopenia. However, muscle wasting in ALS is rapid and severe, whereas sarcopenia progresses gradually over decades, peaking at an advanced age. The molecular mechanisms underlying muscle wasting in these conditions remain incompletely defined. Here, we used the SOD1 G93A ALS mouse model and wild-type mice across the lifespan to generate an integrated single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of skeletal muscle, mapping changes associated with ALS and aging. This atlas is complemented by structural and functional analyses. Our results identify transcriptionally distinct condition-specific myonuclear states, including disease-responsive programs within synaptic myonuclei at the neuromuscular junction, that are shared or distinct between the two conditions. Notably, at early stages, muscle from ALS mice exhibits molecular hallmarks of aged muscle at the myofiber level, indicating premature aging and reinforcing aging as a risk factor in ALS. At advanced disease stages and in old age, myonuclear subpopulations follow similar degenerative pathways in fast glycolytic fibers, consistent with their loss in both conditions. However, a distinct ALS-enriched myonuclei subpopulation displays uniquely regulated genes not observed in aged muscle, potentially underlying the more rapid and severe pathology observed in ALS. This atlas maps shared and divergent mechanisms of muscle degeneration in ALS and sarcopenia and provides a resource for identifying therapeutic targets tailored to each condition.
items.titleZh: ALS与衰老骨骼肌的整合转录组图谱界定退变的共享与独特分子程序
items.summaryZh: 该研究构建了SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠与野生型小鼠全生命周期的骨骼肌单核转录组图谱，并结合结构与功能分析。研究发现ALS早期肌肉在肌纤维层面已呈现衰老肌肉的分子特征，提示过早衰老；疾病晚期与老年肌肉在快速糖酵解纤维中走相似的退变通路；同时存在一个ALS特有的肌核亚群，其基因调控模式不见于衰老肌肉，可能解释ALS肌肉消耗更快更重的特点。
items.insight: 这是目前少有的将ALS与生理性衰老骨骼肌放在同一单核转录组框架下系统比较的资源性工作。它把“ALS是否加速肌肉衰老”这一概念性问题拆解为可操作的肌核状态与通路，并指出ALS特异肌核亚群，为区分“疾病驱动”与“衰老叠加”的肌肉病理、寻找ALS专属肌肉靶点提供了图谱基础。对关注神经肌肉接头、肌核异质性和ALS非神经元病理的研究者具有直接参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 由运动神经元支配丧失导致的骨骼肌萎缩和无力是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和年龄相关肌少症的共同标志。然而，ALS中的肌肉消耗迅速且严重，而肌少症在数十年间逐渐进展，在高龄时达到高峰。这些情况下肌肉消耗的分子机制仍不完全明确。在此，我们使用SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型和跨越生命周期的野生型小鼠，生成了骨骼肌的整合单核转录组图谱，绘制了与ALS和衰老相关的变化。该图谱辅以结构和功能分析。我们的结果识别出转录上不同的条件特异性肌核状态，包括神经肌肉接头处突触肌核内的疾病响应程序，这些程序在两种条件之间共享或不同。值得注意的是，在早期阶段，ALS小鼠的肌肉在肌纤维水平表现出衰老肌肉的分子特征，表明过早衰老，并强化了衰老作为ALS风险因素的作用。在疾病晚期和老年阶段，快速糖酵解纤维中的肌核亚群遵循相似的退变途径，与它们在两种条件下的丢失一致。然而，一个独特的ALS富集肌核亚群显示出在衰老肌肉中未观察到的独特调控基因，可能 underlying ALS中观察到的更快速和严重的病理。该图谱绘制了ALS和肌少症中肌肉退变的共享和分歧机制，并为识别针对每种条件定制的治疗靶点提供了资源。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以单核转录组图谱新近整合ALS与衰老骨骼肌，直接关联ALS肌肉退变机制并具备靶点发现转化价值。

items.title: Salivary Dim-Light Melatonin Onset is Associated with Functional Decline, Respiratory Symptom Emergence, and Survival in Early Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Sleep-wake and circadian disturbances are increasingly recognized in people living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (plwALS), but endogenous circadian phase timing and its prognostic significance in early disease remain unclear. We assessed whether salivary dim-light melatonin onset (DLMO), an objective marker of central circadian phase, is altered in early plwALS and whether it provides prognostic information. In this prospective longitudinal observational study, plwALS within 18 months of symptom onset underwent home-based salivary melatonin sampling under dim-light conditions at 6 predefined time points around habitual sleep onset. Melatonin profiles were modeled using cubic smoothing splines, and DLMO was defined when the fitted curve first reached 3 pg/ml. Clinical, respiratory, and sleep assessments were collected at baseline (T0) and after 6 months (T6); a subgroup repeated saliva sampling at T6. Age- and sex-matched controls underwent melatonin profiling. Associations with disease progression, incident respiratory symptoms, and survival/tracheostomy were examined using regressions and survival analyses. A total of 50 plwALS were enrolled. Compared with controls, plwALS showed an earlier DLMO (20:24 ± 1:18 vs 20:58 ± 0:50; p = 0.028) despite similar habitual sleep onset and chronotype. Within ALS cohort, a later baseline DLMO correlated with worse functional/motor status, faster progression of disease, incident dyspnea/orthopnea by T6 (adjusted OR 3.11; p = 0.019), and poorer survival/tracheostomy-free outcome. In the resampled subgroup (n = 28), DLMO and melatonin-derived metrics did not change over ~6 months. Circadian phase alterations are detectable in early ALS. Baseline DLMO showed exploratory associations with functional, respiratory, and survival outcomes. Larger independent cohorts are required before DLMO can be considered a validated prognostic biomarker. ANN NEUROL 2026.

items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性纵向观察研究纳入50例症状起病18个月内的早期ALS患者，通过居家暗光条件下唾液褪黑素采样评估中枢昼夜节律相位（DLMO）。结果显示早期ALS患者DLMO较健康对照提前，而基线DLMO较晚与更差的功能状态、更快疾病进展、6个月时新发呼吸困难/端坐呼吸及更差的生存/无气管切开结局相关；重复采样亚组中DLMO约6个月内保持稳定。作者强调这些关联为探索性，DLMO尚需更大独立队列验证后才能作为预后生物标志物。
items.insight: 该研究提示一个低成本、可居家采集的昼夜节律相位指标（唾液DLMO）可能与早期ALS的功能、呼吸和生存结局相关，为ALS预后分层和昼夜节律机制研究提供了可检验的假设；但样本量小、关联为探索性，且DLMO在6个月内稳定提示其可能反映个体特质而非疾病动态，需独立大样本验证后方可用于临床决策。

items.abstractZh: 睡眠-觉醒及昼夜节律紊乱在肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者（plwALS）中日益受到关注，但内源性昼夜节律相位时相及其在早期疾病中的预后意义仍不明确。本研究评估唾液暗光褪黑素起始时间（DLMO）——中枢昼夜节律相位的客观标志物——在早期plwALS中是否发生改变，以及其是否提供预后信息。在这项前瞻性纵向观察研究中，症状起病18个月内的plwALS在暗光条件下于习惯性入睡前后6个预设时间点进行居家唾液褪黑素采样。褪黑素曲线采用三次平滑样条建模，DLMO定义为拟合曲线首次达到3 pg/ml的时间。在基线（T0）和6个月后（T6）收集临床、呼吸及睡眠评估；一个亚组在T6重复唾液采样。年龄和性别匹配的对照者接受褪黑素谱检测。采用回归和生存分析检验其与疾病进展、新发呼吸症状及生存/气管切开结局的关联。共纳入50例plwALS。与对照者相比，plwALS的DLMO更早（20:24 ± 1:18 vs 20:58 ± 0:50；p = 0.028），尽管习惯性入睡时间和睡眠时型相似。在ALS队列内，基线DLMO较晚与更差的功能/运动状态、更快的疾病进展、T6时新发呼吸困难/端坐呼吸（校正OR 3.11；p = 0.019）以及更差的生存/无气管切开结局相关。在重复采样亚组（n = 28）中，DLMO及褪黑素衍生指标在约6个月内未发生变化。早期ALS中可检测到昼夜节律相位改变。基线DLMO与功能、呼吸及生存结局显示出探索性关联。在DLMO可被视为经过验证的预后生物标志物之前，需要更大规模的独立队列。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表于Annals of Neurology的前瞻性纵向研究首次在早期ALS中系统评估居家唾液DLMO的预后关联，为昼夜节律生物标志物的转化研究提供了新线索。

items.title: Ataxin-2 downregulation rewires neuronal and astrocytic metabolism to protect against TDP-43 toxicity.
items.summary: Ataxin-2 (ATXN2) is a genetic modifier of TDP-43 toxicity and a promising therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the mechanisms underlying its neuroprotective effects remain poorly understood. Using global proteomic profiling in yeast and mouse TDP-43 models, we establish that pbp1/ataxin-2 (pbp1 is the yeast ataxin-2 ortholog) reduction confers neuroprotection by activating orthogonal stress-adaptive pathways in neurons and glia, rather than simply reversing TDP-43-induced damage. In neurons, ataxin-2 downregulation activates glycolysis and reductive glutamine carboxylation driven by IDH1, restoring ATP production independently of impaired mitochondria. In astrocytes, it upregulates cholesterol biosynthesis via HMGCS1, enhancing trophic support to neurons. Full neuroprotection requires both mechanisms: neuronal survival is only completely rescued when ataxin-2 is reduced in neuron-astrocyte co-cultures. Importantly, ataxin-2 downregulation protects against both TDP-43 gain- and loss-of-function toxicity, broadening its therapeutic relevance. Collectively, these findings establish ataxin-2 as a regulator of stress-adaptive metabolic resilience.

items.summaryZh: 该研究在酵母和小鼠TDP-43模型中揭示，降低ataxin-2（ATXN2）并非单纯抵消TDP-43损伤，而是分别激活神经元糖酵解/IDH1依赖的还原性谷氨酰胺羧化以恢复ATP，以及星形胶质细胞HMGCS1介导的胆固醇合成以增强营养支持；两种机制共同作用才能实现完全神经保护，且对TDP-43功能获得与功能缺失毒性均有效。
items.insight: ATXN2是ALS中少数有遗传学证据支持的修饰靶点，但此前对其保护机制理解有限。该研究把保护效应拆解为神经元与星形胶质细胞两条可分别操作的代谢通路，并强调共培养条件下才完全挽救，提示未来ATXN2靶向策略需评估细胞类型特异性效应及胶质细胞参与，也为代谢干预与基因下调联合提供假设。

items.abstractZh: Ataxin-2（ATXN2）是TDP-43毒性的遗传修饰因子，也是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）一个有前景的治疗靶点。然而，其神经保护作用的机制仍知之甚少。利用酵母和小鼠TDP-43模型的全局蛋白质组学分析，我们确立：pbp1/ataxin-2（pbp1为酵母ataxin-2直系同源物）的降低通过激活神经元和胶质细胞中正交的应激适应通路来提供神经保护，而非简单地逆转TDP-43诱导的损伤。在神经元中，ataxin-2下调激活糖酵解以及由IDH1驱动的还原性谷氨酰胺羧化，从而在不依赖受损线粒体的情况下恢复ATP产生。在星形胶质细胞中，它通过HMGCS1上调胆固醇生物合成，增强对神经元的营养支持。完全神经保护需要这两种机制：只有在神经元-星形胶质细胞共培养中降低ataxin-2时，神经元存活才被完全挽救。重要的是，ataxin-2下调对TDP-43功能获得性和功能缺失性毒性均具有保护作用，拓宽了其治疗相关性。总之，这些发现确立ataxin-2是应激适应性代谢韧性的调节因子。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表于Cell Reports的研究在酵母和小鼠模型中机制性拆解ATXN2下调的神经保护通路，直接关联ALS核心病理TDP-43，并为靶向ATXN2的转化策略提供可检验的代谢节点。

items.title: Interventions to support informal carers managing behavioral symptoms in frontotemporal lobar degeneration: a scoping review.
items.summary: Informal carers of people living with frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) face significant challenges in managing complex behavioral symptoms, yet disease specific support remains limited. This scoping review explored non-pharmacological interventions developed to support this carer population. Database searches were conducted across Medline, APA PsycINFO, CINAHL, ERIC, E-Journals, and Scopus from January 2011 to November 2025, supplemented by hand searching, identifying nine included studies. Interventions broadly comprised occupational therapy-based activity programmes, psychoeducational approaches, and web-based self-management tools. The majority of studies were feasibility or acceptability studies, with findings generally positive; however, behavioral symptoms were inconsistently reported, and sample sizes were small, highlighting that evidence remains at an early stage. Despite the promising nature of existing approaches, structured implementation of non-pharmacological interventions to support informal carers manage behavioral symtoms into clinical practice remains absent. Translating feasible and acceptable interventions into accessible, disease-specific support for carers of people living with FTLD is urgently needed.

items.title: Protein arginine methylation rewires molecular interactions.
items.summary: Protein arginine methyltransferases (PRMT1-9) catalyze monomethylation and dimethylation of arginine residues in RNA- and DNA-associated proteins. Protein arginine methylation can weaken or strengthen nucleic acid binding, recruit or exclude protein partners, and promote or suppress higher-order assembly, making its molecular consequences highly context dependent. Methylation preserves the cationic character of the guanidinium group, while altering hydrogen-bond donor topology, steric accessibility, and interaction geometry. These effects are particularly consequential in intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs), where arginine-rich motifs mediate multivalent protein-protein and protein-nucleic acid interactions. Here, we propose an interaction-equilibrium framework in which arginine methylation redistributes binding capacity among the competing protein, nucleic acid, and assembly states. This framework integrates reader-dependent and reader-independent effects of methylarginine and provides a chemical basis for understanding how a charge-preserving modification can reweight molecular interactions across diverse cellular contexts.

items.title: Needs and Expectations of ALS Patients and Caregivers: An Integrated Perspective.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease requiring complex multidisciplinary care. As disability advances, patients' and caregivers' needs may diverge. to assess needs, priorities and satisfaction with care among people with ALS (pALS) and their caregivers; to examine the association between satisfaction and Quality of life (QoL); to explore differences according to clinical characteristics; to understand the Italian ALS community's willingness to engage in research. In this cross-sectional multicentre study, 154 pALS and 211 caregivers were recruited (July 2021-November 2022). Structured interviews explored information received, care priorities, research expectations and satisfaction. Answers to the interview were compared between patients and caregivers and between different patients' subgroups with the chi-square or the Fisher's exact test. The scores of QoL questionnaires were compared between satisfied vs. unsatisfied with the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney test in patients (ALSAQ-40) and caregivers (SF-36). Patients prioritized finding a cure (95%) and overcoming disease-related limitations (72%) over safe and tolerable drugs (55%), similarly to caregivers. Research on psychological and emotional support was rated more important by caregivers (70%) than patients (49%). QoL was higher among satisfied patients, with better ALSAQ-40 scores in mobility, daily activities, communication and emotional domains. Caregivers needing urgent psychological support were fewer among the satisfied (35%) than the not satisfied (50%), and SF-36 mental health scores were also higher in satisfied caregivers. Incorporating both pALS and caregiver perspectives into clinical practice and research planning may enhance patient- and family-centered care, improve QoL, and better align healthcare research and resources with societal needs.

items.title: Diagnostic evolution of carbonic anhydrase 3 (CA3) in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS): an emerging prognostic biomarker.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease traditionally viewed as a motor neuron disorder in which muscle atrophy occurs secondary to neuronal loss. However, recent clinical proteomic advances have highlighted carbonic anhydrase 3 (CA3), a muscle-enriched enzyme, as a promising biomarker associated with ALS disease progression. Therefore, considering ALS a neurocentric disease is not untenable. In this review, the authors examined the emergence of CA3 as an ALS biomarker and evaluated evidence from recent large-scale clinical consortium studies supporting its diagnostic and prognostic utility. They also compare CA3 with established biomarkers, neurofilament light chain (NEFL), a surrogate endpoint approved by the FDA. Discoveries of CA3 biomarker in ALS highlight that peripheral skeletal muscle is not merely a passive bystander, but an integral participant in ALS disease progression. Unlike NEFL, which primarily reflects neuroaxonal injury, CA3 may capture early neuromuscular dysfunction preceding motor neuron degeneration. CA3's emergence as an ALS biomarker supports a more integrated neuromuscular model of ALS and provides a compelling rationale for incorporating CA3 into multimodal diagnostic, prognostic, and pharmacodynamic biomarker panels to accelerate ALS drug discovery, therapeutic evaluation, and precision clinical trial development, highlighting their complementary roles in early diagnosis, patient stratification, and therapeutic clinical trial design.

items.title: Restoring Neural Homeostasis via Class II HDAC Modulation: Mechanistic Insights and Therapeutic Opportunities.
items.summary: Class II histone deacetylases (HDACs) comprise class IIa enzymes HDAC4, HDAC5, HDAC7, and HDAC9 and class IIb enzymes HDAC6 and HDAC10, which differ substantially in structure, catalytic activity, subcellular localization, and neural function. Class IIa HDACs exhibit weak intrinsic deacetylase activity and function predominantly as signal-responsive scaffolds that couple calcium and kinase signaling to transcription through nucleocytoplasmic shuttling, recruitment of HDAC3-containing NCoR/SMRT corepressor complexes, and interactions with MEF2, CREB, and FOXO. Conversely, HDAC6 is a predominantly cytoplasmic deacetylase that regulates α-tubulin acetylation, cytoskeletal dynamics, axonal transport, autophagy, and proteostasis. Dysregulated class II HDAC signaling contributes to neurodegenerative diseases through convergent mechanisms involving synaptic dysfunction, maladaptive transcriptional repression, mitochondrial impairment, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier disruption, and defective clearance of pathological proteins. Disease-associated substrates include amyloid-β and tau in Alzheimer's disease, α-synuclein in Parkinson's disease, mutant huntingtin in Huntington's disease, and TDP-43/SOD1 in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Emerging evidence additionally links aberrant HDAC4/5 signaling to neurodevelopmental disorders through altered synaptic maturation, excitation-inhibition balance, and circuit development. This review integrates the structural and mechanistic biology of class II HDACs with their disease-specific roles and evaluates therapeutic approaches to restore neural homeostasis. Particular emphasis is placed on selective HDAC6 inhibitors, modulation of class IIa protein-protein interactions and subcellular trafficking, natural compounds, and RNA-based strategies. Finally, we discuss major translational challenges, including isoform specificity, brain penetration, context-dependent functions, and the need to distinguish catalytic from non-enzymic mechanisms when developing disease-modifying interventions for neurological disorders while preserving normal essential HDAC functions and minimizing off-target toxicity.

items.title: Bullous Pemphigoid in Patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Retrospective Study of 1,067 Cases.
items.summary: Background Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects motor neurons. Bullous pemphigoid (BP) is an autoimmune blistering disease associated with autoantibodies against BP180 and BP230. Previous studies have suggested an increased incidence of BP in patients with ALS. However, the neurological status and disease severity of patients with ALS at the time of BP onset remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to investigate the frequency and clinical characteristics of BP in patients with ALS.Methods In this retrospective study, we reviewed the medical records of 1,067 patients with ALS who were admitted to our institution between April 2010 and May 2025. Patients who developed BP after the onset of ALS were identified. BP was diagnosed by dermatologists based on clinical findings and, when available, by immunological or histopathological examinations. Disease severity at BP onset was assessed based on the ambulatory status and ventilatory support requirements.Results Seven of the 1,067 patients (0.66%) developed BP after ALS onset. The median interval between ALS and BP onset was 8.0 years (IQR 5.0-16.5). At BP onset, four patients (57.1%) were bedridden, four (57.1%) required tracheostomy and invasive ventilation, and two (28.6%) required non-invasive ventilation. Five patients (71.4%) required enteral feeding. The median age at BP onset was 68.0 years (IQR, 64.0-72.5). BP180 antibody testing was positive in three of the six patients. The lesions most commonly involved both the extremities and the trunk.Conclusion BP may occur more frequently in ALS patients than in the general population. Clinicians should consider BP when evaluating cutaneous lesions in patients with ALS.
